Time the same computation in mai and in R

Source: R/compare.R
mai_compare.Rd

Runs `mai_code` and `r_code` `reps` times each after one warm-up, and reports the median elapsed seconds. Each side must define a function `run()` taking no arguments; only the calls to `run()` are timed, not start-up or data set-up.

Usage

mai_compare(mai_code, r_code, reps = 5)

Arguments

mai_code

mai code defining `run()`.

r_code

R code (a string) defining `run()`.

reps

Number of timed repetitions.

Value

A data frame with columns `language`, `seconds` and `speedup` (R seconds over mai seconds).

Examples

if (mai_available()) {
  mai_compare(
    "const run = function() { var s = 0.0
       for(int i = 1; i <= 1000000; i = i + 1) s = s + 1.0 / i
       s }",
    "run <- function() { s <- 0; for (i in 1:1e6) s <- s + 1 / i; s }",
    reps = 3)
}
#>   language seconds  speedup
#> 1      mai  0.0093 4.301075
#> 2        R  0.0400 1.000000
